profile.headline: Fullstack Software Engineer | JavaScript | Node.js | React | Redux | Express | Ruby on Rails | CSS | PostgreSQL | MongoDB | Python | HTML | SQL | C
profile.summary:
I am a Fullstack software engineer who is passionate about React and Redux as well Ruby on Rails. I have enjoyed writing in Python and C, and am skilled in HTML and CSS. 
In my personal life I enjoy cooking which contributed in part to the impetus behind Cubberd, an app I helped build using MongoDB, Express, React, and Node, which fetches, queries, and scores recipes based on user input.
I also enjoy reading, running, and doing crossword puzzles in my free time.

Email me: cooperadina@gmail.com

positions.title: Business Analyst
positions.description: Authored requirements management plan (RPM)  that ensured a well-documented and intuitive process for gathering and maintaining technical requirements.

positions.title: Content and Progressions Manager,  Product Operations
positions.description:
Oversaw processes for scheduling over 30 schools and rostering over students to provide personalized math curricula to all students.

Performed User Acceptance Testing for new products before officially rolling them out to the rest of the team.

positions.title: Math Instructional Content Specialist
positions.description:
Wrote and edited math curriculum for Teach To One, a personalized learning model.

Managed a team of three contract writers to develop innovative mathematical content for all students ages 9-15.

positions.title: Elementary School Teacher
positions.description:
Created and implemented engaging, data-driven and culturally-responsive lessons for third- and fourth- grade math classes of 25 students

Coordinated and implemented math support program for third grade math students in the intervention program

Provided after-school academic support two days a week to students needing extra help

Each year, at least 70% of students passed New York State Math test

company.name: Bronx Charter School for Better Learning

positions.title: Student Teacher
positions.description:
Created and ran lessons and assessments for a Gifted and Talented class of 30 students

Taught whole class, small group, and one-on-one lessons

Supported students who struggled with material and helped catch students up to the rest of the class

company.name: P.S. 9 The Teunis E. Bergen School

positions.title: Assessment Consultant
positions.description:
Edited over 200 middle school math assessment questions for publication and coded them from Google Doc to interactive software

Participated in weekly Academic Team meetings regarding progress and future goals

positions.title: Technical Director
positions.description:
In charge of all logistics before, during, and after summer camp

Organized camp trips, budgeted and ordered supplies needed for programming, balanced $30,000 budget, communicated with executive director and caretaker regarding site maintenance

Interviewed and hired staff in advance of summer, planned and executed staff training, supervised staff in daily camp activities
